name: server_config
title: Server Config
description: Show CodexPro server configuration, safety modes, limits, and blocked paths. Does not reveal auth tokens.

name: load_skill
title: Load Skill
description: Load the bounded SKILL.md body for a skill discovered inside the selected sandbox workspace.

name.description: Exact skill name from skill_inventory or codexpro_inventory.

source.description: Optional source override. Without it, the highest-precedence skill is loaded.

path.description: Optional exact sanitized path override for diagnostics or an explicitly selected suppressed duplicate.

include_global_skills.description: Also scan installed user/plugin skills. Default: auto when source/path is not workspace.

max_skills.description: Maximum skills to scan while resolving the requested skill. Default: 500.

max_bytes.description: Maximum bytes to return from SKILL.md. Default: 40000.

name: open_current_workspace
title: Open Current Workspace
description: Open the workspace assigned to the selected sandbox.

include_tree.description: Include a compact file tree. Default: false for speed.

include_skills.description: Discover skills by name/description. Default: false for speed.

include_global_skills.description: Also scan installed user/plugin skills when include_skills=true. Default: false.

name: inspect_workspace
title: Inspect Workspace
description: Build a bounded repository map with languages, project types, entrypoints, areas, symbols, relationships, and coverage warnings.

path.description: Optional workspace-relative area to emphasize. Default: entire workspace.

include_symbols.description: Include symbols in structured output. Default: true.

include_relationships.description: Include relationships in structured output. Default: true.

max_symbols.description: Maximum returned symbols. Analysis remains bounded by server config.

max_relationships.description: Maximum returned relationships. Analysis remains bounded by server config.

name: tree
title: File Tree
description: List files and directories inside the workspace, excluding blocked paths.

path.description: Directory relative to workspace root. Default: .

include_hidden.description: Include dotfiles/dotfolders that are not blocked. Default: false.

name: search
title: Search Files
description: Use this for targeted verification or code lookup. Prefer one specific final search instead of repeated broad verification searches.

query.description: Text or regex to search for.

regex.description: Treat query as a regular expression. Requires ripgrep. Default: false.

path.description: Directory or file relative to workspace root. Default: .

include_hidden.description: Include hidden files that are not blocked. Default: false.

intent.description: Optional structured search intent. Omit for legacy lexical behavior.

symbol.description: Optional symbol query. Uses repository analysis and overrides query text.

include_tests.description: Include related tests in structured results. Default: false.

name: read
title: Read File
description: Read a specific text file with line numbers. Avoid rereading files after write/edit/apply_patch unless exact final content is needed.

path.description: File path relative to workspace root.

end_line.description: Last line to read. Default: end of file.

max_bytes.description: Maximum file bytes. Capped by server config.

name: view_image
title: View Image
description: Inspect a PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP image from the active workspace. Returns native MCP image content plus dimensions and SHA-256.

path.description: Image path relative to workspace root.

max_bytes.description: Maximum image bytes. Default: at least 1 MB, capped at 2 MB.

name: write
title: Write File
description: Create or overwrite a meaningful text file inside the workspace. New files use an atomic rename; existing files retain their inode and metadata. Returns a unified diff; pass the SHA from read when overwriting shared files.

path.description: File path relative to workspace root.

create_dirs.description: Create parent directories if missing. Default: true.

overwrite.description: Allow overwriting existing files. Default: true.

expected_sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 from read. Fails instead of overwriting if another session changed the file.

name: edit
title: Edit File
description: Apply a targeted exact text replacement while retaining the existing file inode and metadata. Returns a unified diff; pass the SHA from read to reject stale multi-session edits.

path.description: File path relative to workspace root.

old_text.description: Exact text to replace. Must match once unless replace_all=true.

expected_replacements.description: Fail if actual replacement count differs.

expected_sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 from read. Fails if another session changed the file.

name: apply_patch
title: Apply Patch
description: Apply one unified diff patch inside the workspace. Paths are validated before applying. Prefer edit for tiny replacements and apply_patch for multi-file diffs.

patch.description: Unified diff patch to apply. File paths must stay inside the workspace and avoid blocked paths.

name: import_file
title: Import Attachment File
description: Import a ChatGPT Apps SDK attachment into the workspace. Accepts only a platform file object with download_url and file_id. Not a general URL downloader. Overwrite is off by default.

download_url.description: Temporary HTTPS download URL provided by ChatGPT.

file_id.description: ChatGPT file id for this attachment.

mime_type.description: Optional MIME type declared by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Optional original file name declared by ChatGPT.

file.description: ChatGPT Apps SDK file reference from openai/fileParams.

destination.description: Destination path relative to the workspace root.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing destination file. Default: false.

expected_sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 of the attachment bytes. Import fails on mismatch.

name: bash
title: Bash
description: Run an unrestricted Bash command inside the selected sandbox workspace. The command can modify sandbox files, use sudo, access the sandbox network, and control the sandbox private Docker Engine. It cannot access the host shell or host Docker daemon.

session_id.description: Optional bash session id. If configured on the server, a provided value must match it.

cwd.description: Working directory relative to workspace root. Default: .

name: show_changes
title: Show Changes
description: Summarize the current workspace changes in one review-oriented result with git status, diff stats, and optional diff. Use this instead of bash git status, bash git diff, git_status, or git_diff when reviewing work.

path.description: Optional file path relative to workspace root.

include_diff.description: Include the unified diff. Default: true.

since.description: Use last_shown to suppress unchanged repeated reviews. Default: last_shown.

mark_reviewed.description: Update the last-shown review checkpoint after this call. Default: true.

name: read_handoff
title: Read Handoff
description: Read the shared .ai-bridge planning files used for ChatGPT-to-agent coordination.

name: wait_for_handoff
title: Wait For Handoff
description: Read-only long-poll of the local handoff run state so ChatGPT can stay the planner/reviewer while a local executor runs. Reads .ai-bridge/handoff-run-state.json and returns the run status plus status/diff/log/test excerpts. It never starts processes or runs shell commands; it only observes local handoff state written by execute-handoff/watch-handoff/loop-handoff.

plan_hash.description: Expected current-plan.md hash. If set, only a terminal run with this plan_hash counts as completed.

since_iteration.description: Only treat a run with iteration greater than this as the awaited completion.

max_wait_seconds.description: Maximum seconds to long-poll before returning the current state. Default: 20.

include_diff.description: Include the implementation diff excerpt when completed. Default: true.

include_log_excerpt.description: Include the tail of execution-log.jsonl when completed. Default: true.

include_tests.description: Include the loop-tests.txt excerpt when completed. Default: true.

name: export_pro_context
title: Export Pro Context
description: Create .ai-bridge/pro-context.md with repo tree, git state, selected files, and handoff context for high-context ChatGPT planning without live MCP tool calls.

title.description: Markdown title for the context bundle.

extra_globs.description: Additional workspace-relative glob patterns to include, for example src/**/*.ts.

include_important_files.description: Auto-include important root config/docs such as AGENTS.md, README.md, and package.json. Default: true.

include_changed_files.description: Auto-include currently changed files from git status. Default: true.

include_diff.description: Include the current git diff. Default: true.

include_ai_bridge.description: Include existing .ai-bridge planning files. Default: true.

max_files.description: Maximum file contents to include. Default: 24.

max_file_bytes.description: Maximum bytes per included file. Default: 60000.

max_total_bytes.description: Maximum bytes in the generated bundle.

name: handoff_to_agent
title: Handoff To Agent
description: Write .ai-bridge/current-plan.md for Codex, OpenCode, Pi, or another local implementation agent. This only creates handoff files; it does not execute local agent commands.

agent.description: Target agent id, for example codex, opencode, pi, or custom. Default: custom.

agent_name.description: Human-readable agent name for custom agents.

model.description: Optional model identifier to include in the handoff plan.

plan.description: Detailed implementation plan for the local agent.

append.description: Append to existing current-plan.md instead of overwriting. Default: false.
